title: Create New Report
subtitle: A few quick steps and we'll generate your report

typeStep.title: Choose a report type
typeStep.lead: Pick the kind of analysis you want to run. We'll tailor the next steps to it.
typeStep.loadTypesFailed: We couldn't load the report types.
typeStep.loadDetailsFailed: We couldn't load the details for this report.

documentsStep.title: Upload documents
documentsStep.leadClassified: Upload the files below. We read each one and work out what it is.
documentsStep.missingRequiredNote: Upload and classify the required document to continue: | Upload and classify the required documents to continue:
documentsStep.singularViolationNote: Only one document of this class is allowed — remove the extras to continue: | Only one document per class is allowed for these classes — remove the extras to continue:
documentsStep.labelLead: Upload the source documents for {name}, then tell us what each one is. The analysis is built from these files.
documentsStep.acceptedTypes: Accepted document types: {types}. Other document types are not supported.
documentsStep.unlabelledNote: Select a document type for each file to continue.
documentsStep.classPartlyOptionalNote: After you upload a document, we work out its type for you. We cannot do this for {documents}. When you upload one, choose its type yourself in the list next to the file. | After you upload a document, we work out its type for you. We cannot do this for these types: {documents}. When you upload one of them, choose its type yourself in the list next to the file.

reRunChanges.title: This workflow has changed since the original run
reRunChanges.lead: Your original inputs and documents are filled in. Check what changed, then submit.
reRunChanges.unavailableDocuments: Deleted since the original run, so left out: {names}
reRunChanges.removed: Removed from the workflow, so left out: {names}
reRunChanges.defaulted: New to the workflow, filled in with its default: {names}

detailsStep.title: Configure the details
detailsStep.lead: Set the @:{'terms.company'}, peers and any parameters this report needs.
detailsStep.inputRulesHeld: Change the fields marked on this step before you continue.

reviewStep.title: Review & generate
reviewStep.lead: Give everything a final check, then generate your report.

form.companyHint: The @:{'terms.company'} the documents are about. Pick one you have used before, or add a new one.
form.peerHint: Compare this @:{'terms.company'} with others. You can choose a @:{'terms.company'} once we hold its financial analysis; the list says why the others cannot be chosen.

errors.uploadFailed: Failed to upload {count} document. Please try again. | Failed to upload {count} documents. Please try again.
